- [QFT FVG Pro – free FVG (fair value gap) indicator for MT5 and MT4](https://qaziforextips.com/fvg-indicator-mt5.html): fair value gaps with the 50% CE line, dynamic fill, inversion FVG (IFVG), balanced price range (BPR), higher timeframe FVGs, trend and killzone tags, and a unique self-test that compares FVGs with random zones of the same shape. Our test of 23,773 FVGs on XAUUSD and EURUSD (2023–2025, M5/M15): a limit at the 50% CE line beat random zones in 8 of 8 tests (31% vs 28% win rate at 1:2), while "touch and bounce" was no better than random. 100% free download, no DLL.

## Research
- [Do fair value gaps work? We tested 23,773 FVGs](https://qaziforextips.com/research-do-fair-value-gaps-work.html): QFT Research report 1. 23,773 fair value gaps on XAUUSD and EURUSD (2023–2025) compared with random zones of the same size: a limit at the 50% CE line beat random zones in 8 of 8 M5/M15 tests (31% vs 28% at 1:2), a plain touch-and-bounce did not (42% vs 41%), trend and killzone filters did not help, and the CE trade alone was about −0.07R before costs. Method, limitations and a CSV summary included.

## Learn
- [Free video courses in Urdu & Hindi](https://qaziforextips.com/youtube.html)
- [Forex Guide](https://qaziforextips.com/forex-guide.html): sessions in Pakistan time, Smart Money Concepts, liquidity, order blocks, FVG, risk management, Gold trading, prop firm challenges.
- [Sawal Jawab (Q&A)](https://qaziforextips.com/group-qa.html): real questions from the Qazi ForeX Tips Facebook group answered by Dr. Qazi in Urdu, English and Roman Urdu/Hindi: MT5 vs TradingView candles, NFP and Gold, floating loss, engulfing, SMC confirmation, Exness deposit and withdrawal, installing MT5 indicators.
- [A buy-side CHoCH on the daily chart](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-choch-daily-buy-entry.html): after a buy-side CHoCH on the daily chart: it is only the first sign; confirm with a body close; wait for the pullback and a higher low; enter on H4/H1 structure break with SL below the higher low; a new lower low means the CHoCH failed (possible IDM).
- ["Even my good trades are going the wrong way"](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-good-trades-losing-risk-management.html): when even good trades keep losing: a good trade follows the rules regardless of result; 5-6 losses in a row are normal at 50% win rate; check market phase (trend/range/news); review the last 20 trades in the journal; halve risk until rhythm returns.
- [Managing a trade when you are away from the screen](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-trade-management-away-from-screen.html): managing a trade when away from the screen: write the management plan before entry (half off at TP1, SL to breakeven), place TP or breakeven before leaving, same rules every day, keep the daily loss limit, journal every loss; partial close/breakeven tools help.
- [CRT (candle range theory)](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-crt-candle-range-theory.html): CRT (candle range theory): second candle must close inside the first candle's range (outside = breakout); SL behind the sweep wick; first target the other side; range candle D1/H4/H2/H1, entry M15/M5 at OB/FVG; EURUSD 2H example; back-test first.
- [FVG entry](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-fvg-entry-wait-for-retest.html): FVG entry: do not enter as soon as the gap forms; wait for price to return and a rejection candle, enter next candle with a tighter stop; if price never returns, skip; big engulfing = wait for 50%/retest, normal engulfing = entry at close; back-test both.
- [Sold the breakdown, but TP only came after a retest and a double top](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-breakdown-retest-double-top.html): selling a trendline breakdown: TP came late because the break candle was weak and support sat just below, so price retested twice and formed a double top; better entry: wait for the retest, enter on rejection or double top, SL above it.
- [Which timeframe should you judge a candle pattern on](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-candle-pattern-which-timeframe.html): which timeframe to judge candle patterns on: the timeframe of your level (daily/H4); read rejection vs momentum at the level; enter on H1/M15 with confirmation; never decide on M1/M5 alone; bigger timeframe = stronger signal.
- [Is forex a scam](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-is-forex-a-scam.html): is forex a scam? the currency market is real; the shortcut is the scam; where real scams are (fixed profit, account managers, signal sellers, unregulated brokers); 4 rules: emotions, money management with daily target, minimum 1:2, price action.
- [Charts first, fee later](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-forex-strategy-seller-scam.html): the 'charts first, fee later' trap in forex groups; why winning screenshots prove nothing; a strategy only works if it fits your psychology and your money/risk plan matches its back-test (worked losing-streak example); red flags.
- [Order block trade plan](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-order-block-trade-plan.html): can you trade an order block? 4 checks (strong move and BOS, unmitigated, higher-timeframe trend, lower-timeframe confirmation), stop beyond the block, 1:2 minimum, example plan.
- [Liquidity indicator in forex](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-liquidity-indicator-forex.html): why no indicator can measure liquidity in spot forex; where stops really sit (previous day high/low, equal highs/lows, session ranges, swings, round numbers); trading the sweep.
- [Why support and resistance fails](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-why-support-and-resistance-fails.html): the answer is in the candles: momentum vs weak breakouts, repeated rejections, retests; real vs fake breakout table; a practice assignment.
- [Herd mentality in forex trading](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-herd-mentality-in-forex-trading.html): bhed chaal explained in Urdu/English with the 2005 Turkey sheep story; why copying the crowd loses money; practice plus correction; 5 ways to stop following the herd.
